scoring_note: No aggregate score is reported. Criterion results apply only to R01-R09 in the supplied synthetic outputs and do not certify scientific correctness.

R01.reason: T01 provides a strong topic-selection procedure and clearly states that search/data checks/trials were not executed, but it does not explicitly identify `research-topic-selection` as the preferred module or describe literature/method modules as named conditional downstream handoffs.
